caption: Every box is one task — the lines are the exact order your code declared.

code:
check_for_new_data = PythonOperator(...)

load_to_snowflake = SQLExecuteQueryOperator(
    task_id="load_to_snowflake",
    conn_id="snowflake_default",
    sql="copy_into_raw_sales.sql",
)

trigger_dbt_build = BashOperator(
    task_id="trigger_dbt_build",
    bash_command="dbt build",
)

check_for_new_data >> load_to_snowflake >> trigger_dbt_build
caption: One dependency line encodes the whole order: check, load, transform.
